selection_method: Rolling weighted selection uses deduplicated eligible competitive usage, agent and coding relevance, capability relevance, and provider and deployment diversity. A valid run additionally requires recorded dataset provenance, privacy thresholds, minimum sample size, missing-data treatment, normalization, confidence, deterministic tie handling, concentration constraints, and approval.
prelaunch_limitations: VibeMaxxing does not yet have representative competitive usage from which to calculate a production T20 cohort.
External datasets may nominate candidates but cannot establish measured VibeMaxxing usage coverage or launch readiness.
No model family, endpoint, agent, runtime, capture path, platform, evidence class, or accounting profile is currently certified.
